structured.answer: I'd go with Harel, the "עוקב מדד S&P 500" track: Harel is a name I know, it's the S&P thing my friends talk about, and the fee is 0.56%, which is about as low as anything I saw. It showed "13.7%" for 3 years. I'm fairly sure, not completely.

stuck.why: The cards all look the same: 0.5-something %, 0% מההפקדות, a little ring chart. Harel alone has about 16 of them, so I stopped trying to compare.

stuck.where: Screens 12 and 18, after I flicked down quickly
stuck.why: I had lost which company I was in, because the company name only shows once at the top of its group. I saw a 'עוקב מדדים - גמיש' at 26.39% for 3 years and couldn't tell whose it was, so I didn't count it.
Lots of tracks just say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' with no number. I couldn't tell if that's bad or simply new.
Something somewhere costs 0.5%, but I didn't know which company. Out of 40 screens I wasn't going to go looking.

findings.what: 40 screens of near-identical cards. Way too many to scroll on a phone, and nothing tells me which one to pick
Company name is only at the top of each group. Once you scroll, you don't know whose track you're looking at
Fees only as small percents. Show me how many ₪ a year that is on my amount
S&P card says 99% מניות and 99% מט"ח. Looks like an error or something I don't get
Many cards show 'פחות מ־3 שנים' with no return number, so I can't compare them
Cheapest fee (0.5%) is mentioned at the top, but there's no way to jump to it
No button or next step to actually open the fund
findings.where: Not seen on screens I read
